description: Identity-path parity cases for the connector hook projector, version 2 (operation specificity, JSON-RPC envelopes, boolean flags with `kind`, ambiguity overriding supplied values, email-shaped ids). Generated by running dashboard-langfuse's src/modules/observations/domain/mutation-identity-projection.ts (on top of commit 1aa3085c99ed17a45e49b26305cca154c7512f61, PR #286) over the v1 cases plus the new ones, with the test-only modules of tests/helpers/work-source-module.ts identityPathParityModules(). `contract` is what GET /api/v1/telemetry/claude-code/hooks/contract serves with those modules active; `expected` is the server projector's output. The case named "module identity key widens the allowlist" depends on the contract's primaryIdentityKeys.
